notificationsPage.title: Real-time hospital alerts and updates
notificationsPage.subtitle: Role-based in-app alerts with PostgreSQL API Cloud Messaging-ready channels for push, email, SMS, sound, and PostgreSQL API refresh updates.
notificationsPage.allReadToast: All visible notifications marked as read.
notificationsPage.searchPlaceholder: Search title, module, group, priority, message...

deliveryPoints: PostgreSQL notifications collection stores hospitalId, target roles, priority, channels, read state, archive state, timestamps, and action links.
PostgreSQL API Cloud Messaging sends push alerts to registered staff and patient devices.
Email and SMS providers can be called from Spring Boot services for appointment, emergency, result, and maintenance alerts.
Real-time listeners should subscribe only to current user's role and hospital active notifications with indexed queries.
Critical alerts use sound and popup toasts; lower-priority alerts stay in the notification center and dashboard widgets.
Every notification creation, read, archive, and delivery failure should be audit logged.
